profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on Instagram Feed and Threads integration into Instagram

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on the Meta View companion App for the Ray Ban Smart-glasses. Currently working on E2E features for the future versions of Reality Labs Smart-glasses.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Meta's FinTech efforts. Starting with Novi, Meta's wallet for their Crypto named Diem (formerly known as Libra). Helped architect the KYC (Know your customer) for the Wallet, this included Document Capture flows, Selfie Verification E2E efforts and other ways of verifying your account like SMS OTP.

Helped rebrand of Meta Pay and architect unified KYC efforts for different surfaces like Donations, NFT and P2P Payments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
In charge of development and architecture for MySudo app. Helped architect various functional areas of Sudo.

Software Manager for Sudo Platform as well as AWS Engineer for Telephony.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: Worked on the Area Management function of the Sales Rabbit Security App Service

positions.title: Research Assistant Biomedical Engineering
positions.description: Worked on signal exponential decay time constant characterization for Sodium MRI for breast cancer detection.

positions.title: App Developer
positions.description:
Worked with a startup company developing iPhone apps for the summer.
Developed 2 apps: MyPlans and Harvard Sailing Team.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
o	Worked with the ASIC Level Design Team of the ASC Unit for the F15 Saudi APG-63(V)3 Radar.
o	Worked with 2 different ASICs on Test Vectors for Honeywell Signal Characterization, AC and DC tests. Helped the designers reach due dates.
o	Programmed in one of the ASICs, a testbench for test vectors timing in VHDL for Honeywell Testing purpose.
